caption: The drawing features a single ornamental bracket design placed horizontally, oriented with the base at the bottom and a vertical mounting edge on the left side. The bracket is composed of intricate scrollwork and foliage motifs, rendered in varying shades of gray with emphasis on depth through shading. The scrolls and leaves intertwine, starting from the left with a large, tightly coiled scroll, followed by flowing S-shaped curves and curled acanthus leaves, which extend along the bracket's length towards the right, ending in another spiral. There is a suggestion of a central stem, from which much of the decoration radiates, and a small acorn-shaped element hangs near the middle. The entire composition sits on a flat, rectangular base, and the background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or decorations.
title: Iron Bracket
